text.card: A red giant 4,366 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.84 solar masses and 12.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,807 K at its surface.
